Ui.Script:
-- Strings. The `X = X or "..."` idiom is MicroMenu.xml's: a real GlobalStrings table -- loaded later wins, and these are the fallbacks for a run without one. ADDONS = ADDONS or "AddOns" ADDON_LIST_ENABLE_ALL = ADDON_LIST_ENABLE_ALL or "Enable All" ADDON_LIST_DISABLE_ALL = ADDON_LIST_DISABLE_ALL or "Disable All" ADDON_LIST_APPLY_NOTE = ADDON_LIST_APPLY_NOTE or "Changes take effect at your next login." OKAY = OKAY or "Okay" CANCEL = CANCEL or "Cancel"
ADDON_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 16 MAX_ADDONS_DISPLAYED = 19
-- The interface benilla implements. Kept as a name rather than a literal at the call site -- because `ui_script::addons::INTERFACE_VERSION` is the same constant on the Rust side and -- the two must not drift. BENILLA_INTERFACE_VERSION = 11200
-- **`## Interface` mismatch, which `GetAddOnInfo`'s `reason` cannot carry.** 1191 §6 reports -- the mismatch and never enforces it — enforcing would refuse most of a real vanilla corpus, -- whose manifests say 11100, 10900, anything — so it is not a reason the addon *cannot* -- load, and `not_loadable` rightly has no arm for it. That left this screen silent about a -- status its char-select twin has always shown, for the same addon: two views of one folder -- (1197 §3) disagreeing. This is the missing half. -- -- Stated divergence, measured: `GetAddOnMetadata` returns the FIRST `## Interface` line -- while the Rust `out_of_date()` accepts a match among ALL of them. **Zero of the 218 corpus -- addons declare it twice**, so the two agree everywhere it is currently observable; a -- manifest that declared 11100 and 11200 would read out-of-date here and current there. function AddonList_OutOfDate(name) local declared = GetAddOnMetadata(name, "Interface") if not declared then -- No `## Interface` at all is SILENT, not out of date — the same rule the char -- select panel pins in `a_manifest_with_no_interface_is_silent`. return nil end return tonumber(declared) ~= BENILLA_INTERFACE_VERSION end
-- The staged edit. `AddonList.original` is the enable state as the panel found it, so -- Cancel can put it back — the reference's `ResetAddOns` over the client's own records, -- which we do not have an engine verb for (SaveAddOns/ResetAddOns are GLUE-namespace -- globals and deliberately absent in-world, decision 1191 §6). AddonList = { offset = 0, original = {} }
function AddonList_Toggle() if AddonListFrame:IsVisible() then AddonList_OnCancel() else AddonList_Show() end end
function AddonList_Show() AddonList.offset = 0 AddonList.original = {} for i = 1, GetNumAddOns() do local name, _, _, _, loadable, reason = GetAddOnInfo(i) -- "enabled" is everything except the player's own DISABLED — a dependency problem -- is not a checkbox state, it is a status line. AddonList.original[name] = not (reason == "DISABLED") end AddonListFrame:Show() AddonList_Update() end
-- One row's worth of facts, so the row painter below reads as a list of assignments -- rather than as a pile of GetAddOnInfo returns. -- Slot 4 is `enabled`, and `url` is not in the in-game return at all: the client registers -- GetAddOnInfo twice and the in-game one (`0x48e390`) answers seven values without a URL, -- where glue's (`0x46d460`) answers eight with one. We had the glue shape here, so this -- read `url` out of slot 4 and then had to RECONSTRUCT `enabled` from the reason token — -- a workaround that existed only because the slot it wanted was occupied by the wrong -- value. `## URL` lives in the manifest either way, so the tooltip asks for it directly. local function rowFacts(index) local name, title, notes, enabled, loadable, reason = GetAddOnInfo(index) return name, (title or name), loadable, reason, enabled, notes, GetAddOnMetadata(name, "URL") end
function AddonList_Update() local total = GetNumAddOns() -- Clamp first: a Disable All that shortens nothing still must not leave the offset -- past the end after the list is re-read. local maxOffset = total - MAX_ADDONS_DISPLAYED if maxOffset < 0 then maxOffset = 0 end if AddonList.offset > maxOffset then AddonList.offset = maxOffset end if AddonList.offset < 0 then AddonList.offset = 0 end
for i = 1, MAX_ADDONS_DISPLAYED do local entry = getglobal("AddonListEntry" .. i) local index = AddonList.offset + i if index > total then entry:Hide() else local name, title, loadable, reason, enabled = rowFacts(index) entry:SetID(index)
local check = getglobal("AddonListEntry" .. i .. "Check") check:SetChecked(enabled)
-- AddonList_Update's own colour rule, its own three values. local label = getglobal("AddonListEntry" .. i .. "Title") label:SetText(title) if loadable then label:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.78, 0.0) elseif enabled and reason ~= "DEP_DISABLED" then label:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.1, 0.1) else label:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end
-- The status column: the reference splices its token into a GlobalStrings -- lookup (`getglobal("ADDON_"..reason)`), which is why the token spelling is -- load-bearing (1191 §6). A token with no string falls back to the token, so -- a player sees something rather than a blank. local status = getglobal("AddonListEntry" .. i .. "Status") if reason then status:SetText(getglobal("ADDON_" .. reason) or reason) elseif AddonList_OutOfDate(name) then -- INTERFACE_VERSION ("Out of date"), which `reason` can never carry here -- and which the char-select twin has always shown. The two screens are the -- same job (1197 §1) and were answering DIFFERENTLY about the same addon: -- glue read `## Interface` off the folder, this one asked `GetAddOnInfo`, -- and `not_loadable` has no interface arm — because 1191 §6 reports the -- mismatch and never enforces it, so it is not a reason the addon cannot -- load. Surfaced separately for exactly that reason: `loadable` stays true -- and most of a real vanilla corpus keeps loading. status:SetText(ADDON_INTERFACE_VERSION or "Out of date") else status:SetText("") end entry:Show() end end
-- The scroll pair exists only while the list overflows — the reference's own -- GlueScrollFrame_Update condition. if total > MAX_ADDONS_DISPLAYED then AddonListScrollUp:Show() AddonListScrollDown:Show() else AddonListScrollUp:Hide() AddonListScrollDown:Hide() end end
function AddonList_Scroll(delta) AddonList.offset = AddonList.offset + delta AddonList_Update() end
function AddonList_ToggleEntry(entryIndex) local name, _, _, _, _, reason = GetAddOnInfo(entryIndex) if reason == "DISABLED" then EnableAddOn(name) else DisableAddOn(name) end AddonList_Update() end
function AddonList_SetAll(on) if on then EnableAllAddOns() else DisableAllAddOns() end AddonList_Update() end
function AddonList_OnOk() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") AddonListFrame:Hide() end
-- Cancel restores what the panel found, addon by addon — `ResetAddOns` written out, -- because that verb is glue-only and this window is not the glue. function AddonList_OnCancel() PlaySound("igMainMenuQuit") for i = 1, GetNumAddOns() do local name = GetAddOnInfo(i) local was = AddonList.original[name] if was == true then EnableAddOn(name) elseif was == false then DisableAddOn(name) end end AddonListFrame:Hide() end
-- The hover tooltip: title, notes, dependencies — AddonTooltip_Update's three lines in -- its order, on the shared GameTooltip rather than a private frame. function AddonList_RowEnter(row) local name, title, loadable, reason, enabled, notes = rowFacts(row:GetID()) GameTooltip:SetOwner(row, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:AddLine(title) if notes and notes ~= "" then GameTooltip:AddLine(notes, 1, 1, 1) end local deps = "" local list = { GetAddOnDependencies(row:GetID()) } for i = 1, getn(list) do if i == 1 then deps = (ADDON_DEPENDENCIES or "Dependencies: ") .. list[i] else deps = deps .. ", " .. list[i] end end if deps ~= "" then GameTooltip:AddLine(deps, 1, 0.82, 0) end GameTooltip:Show() end
function AddonList_RowLeave() GameTooltip:Hide() end
